title: India government announces new home cleaning schedule
summary: The Indian government has announced a new home cleaning schedule, which recommends cleaning homes on specific days of the week. The schedule is based on Hindu astrology and aims to promote cleanliness and spiritual growth. The government claims that this will lead to better mental health and well-being for citizens. However, opposition parties have alleged that this is an attempt to impose a personal agenda on citizens. The police have stated that they will enforce the new schedule but will not penalize those who do not comply.
